channel.title: The English Garden - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The English Garden (theenglishgarden.co.uk)

item.title: Calla lily houseplant care guide for growing strong plants with beautifully sculptural flowers
item.description: Sculptural and romantic, the calla lily is one of the most entrancing plants for both indoors and outdoors. If you are growing calla lilies as a houseplant, they bring elegance and sleek modernity to your space and are remarkably easy to care for with the right tips and tricks.

item.title: The best trees and shrubs for spring: what experienced gardeners plant now for months of colour and effortless impact
item.description: Geoff Stebbings offers a reminder that the fresh spring foliage of trees and shrubs can be colourful, too – and well worth considering in your planting schemes

item.title: The complete guide to Jade plant care and how to help this timeless succulent thrive in your home
item.description: Gleaming like polished jade, the thick, glossy leaves and tree-like branches of this succulent make a jade plant a must-have addition to your home.

item.title: A practical guide to the best cordless lawnmowers for every garden size and lifestyle
item.description: From the longest battery run time, the ease of charging and assembly, and the quality of the cut, we put the leading cordless lawn mowers to the test to see which helped us achieve the most immaculate striped lawn. to see which performed the best on our garden. We took into consideration the quality of cut, battery run and charge time, ease of assembly and customer experiences.

item.title: Bored of carrots and the usual veg plot suspects? Mark Diacono suggests some unusual edibles to sow this spring
item.description: Ring the changes this year and grow these crops with a difference, including Mark’s favourites for an early harvest: sweet cicely and salad burnet

item.title: Discover the story behind how artificial-flower-maker Anne Tomlin creates lifelike blooms from her West Sussex studio
item.description: Experienced milliner Anne Tomlin has found a second act to her long career, making exquisitely detailed artificial flowers inspired by nature.

item.title: How to grow and care for a fiddle leaf fig – the simple secrets to lush, glossy leaves that transform your space
item.description: A fiddle leaf fig is a dramatic statement houseplant, but they can be a tad fussy about their routine, so to have success, there are a few care considerations you need to keep in mind.

item.title: How to get rid of aphids – the quick-response plan gardeners use when plants start to suffer
item.description: Perhaps the most common of all garden insect pests, the blanket term ‘aphid’ includes many species of greenfly and blackfly that target a range of different plants. Often, little or no treatment is required, as these creatures are eaten by many other garden animals.

item.title: How to grow sweetpeas – fill your garden and your life with breathtaking colour, intoxicating fragrance, and endless summer blooms
item.description: At Easton Walled Gardens in Lincolnshire, sweet peas bloom in spellbinding profusion each summer. Lady Ursula Cholmeley shares how the gardens grow such a beautiful, fragrant display.

item.title: The best garden birdbaths – the standout designs that turn even small gardens into wildlife hotspots
item.description: Serving both a practical and decorative function, bird baths are an elegant addition to the garden space and a focal point that attracts and serves the needs of wildlife.
